company_overview: Postman is an API platform for building and using APIs. Postman simplifies each step of the API lifecycle and streamlines collaboration so you can create better APIs—faster.
target_audience_icp: Developers, engineers and enterprises that need to design, test, manage and distribute APIs.

company_overview: Supabase provides a fully managed Postgres database with built-in authentication, realtime, storage, edge functions, and AI‑ready vector extensions. It offers an open-source backend platform that lets developers quickly build, scale, and secure applications without managing infrastructure.
target_audience_icp: Developers, innovation teams, and enterprises building web, mobile, or AI applications that need a scalable, secure, open-source Postgres backend.

company_overview: Vapi offers a unified platform that enables enterprises to build, test, and deploy voice agents quickly, handling all telephony and infrastructure needs. The platform provides real-time monitoring, AI guardrails, and enterprise-grade security and compliance features for large-scale deployments.
target_audience_icp: Enterprises and developers requiring scalable, secure voice-agent solutions with compliance and high-volume call handling.
